Patient: Casey Trialton   DOB: August 21, 1978   MRN: T5468285
*** SYNTHETIC RECORD - NOT A REAL PATIENT ***
Author: A. Mbeki, MD
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Assessment: severe tricompartmental osteoarthritis of the right knee.

PMH: mild intermittent asthma, GERD. PSH: none reported. Allergies: no known drug
allergies. Social: former smoker, quit over ten years ago. Lives with family.

Exam: Vitals reviewed. Well-appearing. Cardiopulmonary exam unremarkable. Abdomen soft.
Extremities without gross deformity. Mental status at baseline per patient.

Plan: right total knee arthroplasty after medical clearance.

Medication reconciliation completed and reviewed with the patient. Patient given
opportunity to ask questions; all questions answered. Patient agrees with plan.
